title: Symptom Severity Trend
dataSources: Symptom logs (`condition:symptom`), medication doses (`medication:dose`), vitals readings (`vitals:reading`), flare-up events (`flareup:event`), lab results (`labresult:value`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management — symptom and medication trackers (Bearable, MyTherapy), connected blood-pressure cuffs and glucometers, and lab-result portals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=condition:symptom
| timechart span=1d avg(severity) as avg_severity by symptom
| untable _time symptom avg_severity
description: Trends how severe each of your tracked symptoms is over time so you and your doctor can spot whether things are improving or worsening.
value: A clear severity trend turns a vague sense of 'feeling worse' into evidence you can bring to an appointment and act on.
implementation: Ingest daily symptom scores into `index=personal`; trend each symptom and review before appointments.
visualization: Line chart of symptom severity over time, one line per symptom.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your symptoms are getting better or worse over the weeks, giving your doctor something real to look at.
